book.title: Biochemistry
book.readers: university medical biochemistry; one lecture-slide PDF per chapter (Medical Biochemistry & Molecular Biology lectures after Vasudevan, Chatterjea and Lippincott); each chapter is a unit of lessons
book.pilot: none of its own: the look, voice and models are Biology's (books/biology/style.json), whose approved pilot is biology chapter-03/lesson-02
book.layout: same as Biology: lessons in site/biochemistry/chapter-NN/lesson-NN/; CHAPTER.number = chapter*100 + lesson (101); cards relinked by index.html; progress key animebook:progress:biochemistry pinned in lib/book.css
book.use: published openly on GitHub Pages beside Biology by the user's choice (2026-11-27), after being told the lecture slides are likely in copyright; the PDFs and extracted pages are never pushed

words: Intake 2026-11-27: a new subject, titled Biochemistry; same look, voice and models as Biology; chapter order amino acids, protein types, protein structure and folding.

Art: Flat vector, in code — clean flat shapes drawn in code (a tree, a beach, a lake); the camera pushes in to ball-and-stick water molecules whose hydrogen bonds snap and form; labels on what they name.
Cast: Molecules only — no humans; the molecules carry every scene, everyday settings are backdrops.
Look: Deep-water board — dark navy board, cream ink; oxygen red, hydrogen white, H-bonds dashed cyan, heat orange, cold blue; system UI font.
chapter-03/lesson-02 storyboard: Motion + fixes — camera pushes into the tree trunk and into the cell, stronger differences or fewer moments in units and specific heat, a fuller practice screen.
chapter-03/lesson-02 storyboard: Keep them — exaggerated molecule speed differences (still following √T) and illustrative temperatures are fine for teaching.

meaning.free energy: height on the diagram (G up, progress across)
meaning.H+ / proton: #ff7aa8 disc with + (acid colour); H atom white ball carrying a gold electron
meaning.NAD+ / NADH: #e8a87c peach shuttle (empty with + / carrying 2 e- and H); FAD / FADH2 smaller tan #c9b27a shuttle
meaning.oxidation / reduction: outgoing orange #f39a2b arrow (loses e-) / incoming blue #6c8cff arrow (gains e-)
meaning.carbon: #9aa3ad grey beads; CO2 grey C with two red O; pyruvate coral #f07a6a 3-bead chain; CoA teal #4fa3a5 tag
meaning.respiration stages: glycolysis #5fb8c9, pyruvate oxidation #d9826a, citric acid cycle #d0533d, oxidative phosphorylation #8a7ad1
meaning.electron transport chain: complexes I-IV #6c8cff, iron dots #c46a3c; ATP synthase #5b6ee1 with a lighter rotor

look.notation: °C, cal, kcal, J with a space (1 cal = 4.184 J); δ+ / δ− for partial charges; H₂O with subscripts; 5′ and 3′ with the prime ′ (U+2032); µm and nm with a space (0.5 µm, 25 nm)

pacing.checks: one or two quick checks inside the lesson, practice at the end

scenes.art: flat vector drawn in code on the navy board; everyday settings as simple backdrops; camera pushes in from scene to molecules

cast.name: amino acid
cast.look: ball-and-stick alpha carbon with blue amino group, pink carboxyl, white H and a coloured side-chain badge; no human characters

scenes.storyboard: no storyboard stop (the user's standing choice); lessons self-check against Biology's approved lessons

components.name: waterMolecule
components.what: ball-and-stick H2O with face; δ+/δ− labels on demand; jiggle speed from temperature; look, blink, hold hands

components.name: hBond
components.what: dashed cyan link H→O between molecules; snaps with a flash, draws on when formed

components.name: moleculeCrowd
components.what: a region of molecules at a temperature: ice lattice, liquid, escaping gas; its thermometer reads from the same motion

components.name: heatArrow + thermometer
components.what: wavy orange heat-flow arrow; thermometer with live °C readout from the same function as the motion

components.name: beaker
components.what: glass of water, origin at the bottom centre; .surface gives the water line

components.name: wAim
components.what: turn a molecule so a chosen hydrogen points at a target (to line up H-bonds)

components.name: wAtom
components.what: lettered atom ball (O, H, Na, Cl)

components.name: electronCloud
components.what: shared-electron cloud with two circling electrons, .set(a,b,bias,t)

components.name: wLobes
components.what: oxygen's two negative regions, follow the molecule's pose

components.name: wAngle
components.what: H–O–H angle arc that draws on

components.name: wAim2
components.what: point both hydrogens at two targets

components.name: wOnOff
components.what: an H-bond that breaks and re-forms as a function of time

components.name: wIon
components.what: Na+/Cl- ion as a disc with face, charge badge and dashed ring

components.name: wShellSlot
components.what: position of water k of n in a hydration shell (O toward cation, H toward anion)

components.name: volFlask
components.what: volumetric flask with fill mark; .set(k) fills it

components.name: wIonChar
components.what: H+, OH-, H3O+ or H2O in the water molecule's own frame, pink/indigo ring and charge badge

components.name: pHStrip
components.what: pH scale pink-cream-indigo with .at(pH), .marker(), .band(a,b)

components.name: wProtein
components.what: 16-bead chain that folds or loosens with .set(fold, t)

components.name: wChem
components.what: upright chemical formulas from ^/_ markup (also wChemSet, wChemEl, wChemParts)

components.name: wSci
components.what: number formatting: 3.162e-9 as 3.2 × 10⁻⁹ (also wPH, wHof, wDec)

components.name: wAcid
components.what: weak-acid character: .hold(k) HA (pink, holds its H) to A- (indigo, minus badge); .hp()

components.name: wFracBar
components.what: bar split acid / conjugate base with percentages; .set(f)

components.name: wAmmonia
components.what: NH3, or NH4+ with plus

components.name: wBaseFrac
components.what: base fraction from pH and pKa (also wSplitFrac(Ka, C))

components.name: macro.js (chapter 5 kit)
components.what: monomer beads, polymer chain with dehydration/hydrolysis, nucleotide, base shapes, polynucleotide, DNA ladder/helix, cell with nucleus and ribosome, mRNA; API in its header

components.name: metab.js (chapter 8 kit)
components.what: pathway strip, energy diagrams (E_A, ΔG), ATP/ADP/Pi and the ATP cycle, enzyme with active site and induced fit, catalytic cycle, inhibitors, cofactors, rate curves, allosteric enzyme, feedback pathway; API in its header

components.name: protein.js (biochemistry kit)
components.what: amino acid (alpha carbon, amino, carboxyl, H, R side chain by class), the 20 side chains, peptide bond formation, polypeptide bead chain with N and C ends, alpha helix, beta sheet, bonds (H-bond, disulfide, salt bridge, hydrophobic), folded globule, subunit assemblies, prosthetic groups, denaturation; API in its header

approved.why: the shared model lesson: Biology's approved pilot (see books/biology/style.json)
